title: Lo Mein
description: Chinese-style lo mein with chicken, cabbage and carrot tossed in a soy-oyster sauce — packed with protein and ready in 20 minutes.

ingredients.text: 80g dry thin wheat noodles or egg noodles

steps: Cook noodles; drain. Chop cabbage, carrot and onion. Cut chicken into strips. Grate garlic.
Fry chicken in oil on medium-high 1 min per side; add onions; fry 1 min. Remove.
Add cabbage and carrot with a splash of water; fry 6–7 min. Add garlic 20 sec. Remove.
Add cooked noodles to pan; stir-fry 1 min.
Return chicken and vegetables; add soy + oyster sauce; toss 30 sec. Done.
notes: Originally made with shirataki noodles (10 kcal/100g). Swapped for 80g dry wheat noodles (~280 kcal). Macros adjusted accordingly. Add cornstarch slurry for a thicker sauce.
